entry.speaker: seraphina
entry.text: Hi! Let's play!

entry.speaker: seraphina
entry.text: I need your help making sure Dad never finds this!

entry.speaker: seraphina
entry.text: Ooh, a warm crackly fire!

entry.speaker: seraphina
entry.text: A funny little toadstool!

entry.speaker: seraphina
entry.text: Ooh, did something sparkle?

entry.speaker: dad
entry.text: Seraphina, time for bed!

entry.speaker: seraphina
entry.text: I want to pick an apple!

entry.speaker: seraphina
entry.text: I want to read a book!

entry.speaker: seraphina
entry.text: Again! Again!

entry.speaker: seraphina
entry.text: My wardrobe, full of pretty clothes!

entry.speaker: seraphina
entry.text: My cozy bed. Time to sleep!

entry.speaker: sneak
entry.text: My spell book says faeries are REAL. I'm going to prove it!

entry.speaker: sneak
entry.text: Shhh! This book is full of secrets.

entry.speaker: morgana
entry.text: Hi Seraphina! Wanna play?

entry.speaker: morgana
entry.text: I found a shiny pebble!

entry.speaker: dad
entry.text: Hello, my little helper!

entry.speaker: dad
entry.text: I keep all my tools in this shed.

entry.speaker: sneak
entry.text: My spell book has a faerie spell! We need three magic stones.

entry.speaker: sneak
entry.text: A ruby, a sapphire, and a malachite! You'll need a hammer to crack them.

entry.speaker: sneak
entry.text: I saw a hammer near the well!

entry.speaker: sneak
entry.text: Crack the stones with your hammer!

entry.speaker: sneak
entry.text: We have them all! Meet me at the Secret Cave.

entry.speaker: seraphina
entry.text: Axe!

entry.speaker: seraphina
entry.text: Hammer!

entry.speaker: seraphina
entry.text: Malachite!

entry.speaker: seraphina
entry.text: Ruby!

entry.speaker: seraphina
entry.text: Sapphire!

entry.speaker: seraphina
entry.text: I need my axe!

entry.speaker: seraphina
entry.text: I need my hammer!

entry.speaker: sneak
entry.text: You made it! Stand by the fire.

entry.speaker: sneak
entry.text: Press the red button!

entry.speaker: sneak
entry.text: Now the green button!

entry.speaker: sneak
entry.text: Now the blue button!

entry.speaker: sneak
entry.text: Try the red one!

entry.speaker: sneak
entry.text: Try the green one!

entry.speaker: sneak
entry.text: Try the blue one!

entry.speaker: sneak
entry.text: Faeries! Real faeries!

entry.speaker: morgana
entry.text: So pretty!

entry.speaker: sneak
entry.text: We did it! Thank you, Seraphina.

entry.speaker: sneak
entry.text: This shiny gold coin is for you!

entry.speaker: dad
entry.text: Three little bunnies are stuck in the woods!

entry.speaker: dad
entry.text: Little trees are all around the bunnies! Find them in the woods.

entry.speaker: dad
entry.text: Chop the little trees with your axe!

entry.speaker: dad
entry.text: Bunnies love carrots! Find three in the woods.

entry.speaker: dad
entry.text: Give a bunny a carrot and walk it home to me!

entry.speaker: dad
entry.text: Two more bunnies to go!

entry.speaker: dad
entry.text: One more bunny to go!

entry.speaker: dad
entry.text: All three bunnies are home!

entry.speaker: dad
entry.text: The bunnies want you to have this shiny gold coin!

entry.speaker: seraphina
entry.text: Bunny!

entry.speaker: seraphina
entry.text: Carrot!

entry.speaker: seraphina
entry.text: One bunny at a time, silly!

entry.speaker: seraphina
entry.text: The bunny wants a carrot!

entry.speaker: morgana
entry.text: Will you read me a story?

entry.speaker: morgana
entry.text: There is a storybook on the bookshelf!

entry.speaker: morgana
entry.text: Come and sit on the rug with me!

entry.speaker: morgana
entry.text: Press the green button to open the book!

entry.speaker: morgana
entry.text: All the way to the moon!

entry.speaker: morgana
entry.text: A baby dragon!

entry.speaker: morgana
entry.text: Sparkles everywhere!

entry.speaker: morgana
entry.text: That was the best story ever! Thank you Seraphina.

entry.speaker: morgana
entry.text: Big hug! I love story time.

entry.speaker: morgana
entry.text: Here is a shiny gold coin for the best reader!

entry.speaker: seraphina
entry.text: Storybook!

entry.speaker: seraphina
entry.text: Pip the dog zoomed up to the moon!

entry.speaker: seraphina
entry.text: On the moon Pip met a baby dragon!

entry.speaker: seraphina
entry.text: The dragon sneezed sparkles all over Pip!

entry.speaker: seraphina
entry.text: Now Pip and the dragon are best friends!

entry.speaker: seraphina
entry.text: I read my little sister a whole story.

entry.speaker: seraphina
entry.text: I took three little bunnies home to their den.

entry.speaker: seraphina
entry.text: We called real faeries out of the fire.

entry.speaker: seraphina
entry.text: I helped my friend look for magic stones.

entry.speaker: seraphina
entry.text: I cracked a magic stone right open.

entry.speaker: seraphina
entry.text: I chopped a whole tree down with my axe.

entry.speaker: seraphina
entry.text: Good morning! A brand new day!

entry.speaker: seraphina
entry.text: Goodnight, world. See you in the morning.
